title: Beautiful Curtain rods and Holdbacks
text: Beautiful Curtain rods and Holdbacks. I was looking for something to spruce up my living room. I previously had had some standard gold rods which really had seen better days along with cloth tie backs. I saw Levelor Sienna rods and holdbacks and decided to try them out. First the quality of them is amazing. Second, the color is dark and rich and looks so much nicer than the old gold ones. They make my living room look rich and have transformed the room from a standard looking room into a beautiful designer room. Thanks Levelor and Amazon. These are just what I needed!

product_metadata.title: Kenney Sphere 3/4" Standard Decorative Window Curtain Rod, Brushed Sienna, 36-66"
features: Set includes 2 finials, 3 brackets, a 0.75-inch diameter rod and mounting hardware
Sphere finial design connects soft geometric circles to elevate your home décor
Easily adjusts from 36-to-66-Inch to fit most standard size windows
Rods can be easily cleaned with a soft dry cloth
description: From Levolor, the window design authority, these 0.75-inch decorative rod sets are designed for a relaxed lifestyle, perfect for light to medium weight draperies, curtains, sheers, or valances. The 0.75-inch rod diameter can be used with most drapery rod pockets, or tab tops. For easier opening and closing, or to hang pleated draperies, use with Kenney Clip Rings available in coordinating finishes (sold separately). Set includes 2 finials, 3 brackets, a 0.75-inch diameter rod and mounting hardware. The Kenney Sphere finial design connects soft geometric circles to elevate your home décor. Telescoping steel rods are sturdy and easily adjustable from 36-to-66-Inch to fit most standard size windows. Kenney offers additional set sizes, holdbacks and clip rings to complete your entire decorating project. Rods can be easily cleaned with a soft dry cloth. Since the early 1900's Kenney has been setting the standard in window fashions, design innovation, product quality and customer satisfaction. Kenney remains the most recognized name in custom window coverings today. Kenney continues to offer great blinds and shades solutions in a wide variety of vertical, aluminum and wood blinds; cellular and woven wood shades; and sheer vertical window treatments. Kenney has expanded its product offering to include beautiful decorative drapery hardware, distributed nationally through home centers and other retailers.
